info.title: SDKWork Payment Aggregate API
info.description: Definition-only OpenAPI contract for SDKWork unified payment aggregation. The contract standardizes payment order creation, confirmation, cancellation, refund, reconciliation, webhook, provider capability, and controlled provider-native operations. The first supported provider set is WeChat Pay, Alipay, Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, with domestic acquiring providers added later through catalog and capability expansion. Runtime payment processing handlers are not implemented by this document.

get.description: Lists SDKWork payment providers and the normalized capabilities exposed by each payment channel. The first supported provider set includes WeChat Pay, Alipay, Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Domestic acquiring providers such as UnionPay, YeePay, JD Pay, China UMS, Lakala, LianLian Pay, Allinpay, Fuiou Pay, Sandpay, Huifu Pay, Baofoo, and 99Bill are extension providers that can be enabled later through catalog and capability expansion.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to filter provider availability.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to filter provider availability.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Capability that must be supported by returned providers.

get.description: Retrieves normalized capability metadata for a single provider, including supported order scenes, refund modes, statement types, webhook events, and provider-native operation names.

Lists normalized payment methods that SDKWork can route to one or more payment channels, such as WeChat JSAPI, Alipay app, Stripe Checkout, PayPal Checkout, UnionPay QuickPay, JD Pay, bank transfer, and card payments.

parameters.name: providerCode
parameters.description: Provider code used to narrow supported methods.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.description: Checkout scene used to filter method support.

get.description: Lists unified payment orders by merchant order number, provider, status, or creation time.

parameters.name: merchantOrderNo
parameters.description: Merchant order number assigned by the caller.

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for payment intent creation time.

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound for payment intent creation time.

post.description: Creates a unified payment order and maps it to the selected or routed provider. This is the standard SDKWORK abstraction over native provider order APIs such as WeChat Pay transactions, Alipay trade create/page pay, Stripe PaymentIntent or Checkout Session, PayPal Orders, and future domestic acquiring provider order APIs.

get.description: Retrieves a unified payment order and its latest normalized provider state.

post.description: Confirms or starts payment for a unified payment intent. The response carries normalized next actions, such as redirect URLs, QR code URLs, JSAPI parameters, mobile SDK payloads, card confirmation tokens, or provider-native identifiers.

200.description: Payment intent confirmed or actionable next step returned.

post.description: Captures an authorized payment intent through providers that support authorize-and-capture flows, including card, PayPal, Stripe, and domestic acquiring channels that separate authorization from settlement.

200.description: Payment intent captured or latest capture state returned.

post.description: Cancels or closes a payment order through the selected provider when the provider supports cancellation or close operations.

200.description: Payment intent cancelled or latest state returned.

get.description: Lists unified refund records by payment, merchant refund number, provider, status, or creation time.

parameters.name: merchantRefundNo
parameters.description: Merchant refund number assigned by the caller.

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for refund creation time.

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound for refund creation time.

post.description: Creates a unified refund and maps it to the provider-native refund API. Supports full and partial refunds where available.

get.description: Retrieves a unified refund record and the latest provider refund state.

post.description: Cancels a refund when the underlying provider supports refund cancellation or reversal.

get.description: Lists provider statement files and normalized settlement windows for bill download, reconciliation, and finance review.
Retrieves a single provider statement metadata record, including normalized statement status, business date, download URL, and provider-native identifiers.

post.description: Creates or retrieves a provider statement download task and returns a signed URL or async task id. The API normalizes native bill download concepts such as WeChat bill date, Alipay bill type, Stripe balance transaction report, PayPal transaction report, and future domestic acquiring settlement files.
Creates a reconciliation run comparing SDKWork records with provider statements and normalized provider events.

get.description: Retrieves reconciliation task status and summarized difference counts.

Lists normalized reconciliation differences for a task so finance and operations systems can review missing, amount-mismatched, status-mismatched, duplicate, fee, settlement, and chargeback differences consistently across providers.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Difference type used to filter returned rows.

post.description: Verifies a provider webhook signature and returns normalized event metadata without executing business side effects.

Accepts a provider webhook delivery, verifies it where possible, normalizes the payment event, and stores an SDKWORK webhook event record without exposing provider-specific payload shapes to SDK callers.

get.description: Lists normalized payment webhook events received from provider channels.

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for webhook event creation time.

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound for webhook event creation time.

post.description: Replays a normalized webhook event through SDKWORK payment event processing once the payment aggregation runtime is implemented.

Defines the SDKWORK controlled envelope for provider-native payment operations that are not yet promoted into the unified API. This is intended for strict allow-listed operations such as provider-specific order query, statement export, card tokenization, or merchant account verification. It must not bypass SDKWORK authentication, idempotency, auditing, or provider routing controls.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable idempotency key for write operations.

ProviderWebhookDeliveryIdHeader.name: X-Provider-Webhook-Delivery-Id
ProviderWebhookDeliveryIdHeader.description: Provider webhook delivery identifier when the payment channel supplies one.

PaymentProviderCode.description: SDKWORK normalized payment provider code. Initial production support focuses on WeChat Pay, Alipay, Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Additional domestic acquiring providers are extension codes that must be enabled through provider catalog and capability records before use.

MoneyAmount.description: Decimal money amount. Amounts are strings to avoid floating point loss.

amount.description: Decimal amount in major currency units.

ProviderNativeOptions.description: Provider-native request extension fields. Values are passed through only after SDKWORK validates the provider, operation, and allowed fields.

MediaResource.description: SDKWORK standard media resource object. Clients must keep the object shape through API and SDK layers and only extract a delivery URL at rendering or provider handoff boundaries.

PaymentProviderOptions.description: Optional provider-specific request extensions grouped by provider. Mainstream providers get first-class fields. Future domestic acquiring providers should use extension until promoted into first-class SDKWORK fields.

PaymentPayer.description: Payer information used by providers that require buyer identity or client context.

openId.description: WeChat OpenID or equivalent channel user id.

buyerId.description: Alipay buyer id, PayPal payer id, Stripe customer id, or equivalent provider user id.

clientIp.description: Client IP address when required by the provider.

PaymentNextAction.description: Normalized next action that the client should perform to complete payment.

qrCode.description: QR code image media resource. Clients extract a concrete URL only at the rendering boundary.

clientSecret.description: Client confirmation secret for card or wallet SDKs.

sdkPayload.description: Mobile SDK, JSAPI, mini program, or provider client payload.

ProviderNativeReference.description: Provider-native identifiers and response metadata kept alongside the normalized SDKWORK record.

prepayId.description: WeChat Pay prepay id or equivalent pre-order id.

tradeNo.description: Alipay trade number or equivalent provider trade id.

raw.description: Masked provider-native response payload for audit and troubleshooting.

PaymentIntentCreateRequest.description: Unified SDKWORK payment intent creation request.

subject.description: Payment subject shown to the payer where supported.

notifyUrl.description: Merchant webhook URL for asynchronous notifications.

metadata.description: Merchant metadata attached to the payment.

PaymentCaptureRequest.description: Unified payment capture request for providers that support authorization and delayed capture.

finalCapture.description: Whether this capture should close any remaining authorized amount.

metadata.description: Merchant metadata attached to this capture.

items.description: Optional item-level refund allocations. When present, the sum of item refund, tax refund, and shipping refund amounts must equal the refund amount.

metadata.description: Merchant metadata attached to the refund.

PaymentRefundItemCreateRequest.description: Item-level refund allocation used for order, invoice, tax, shipping, and reconciliation evidence.

orderItemId.description: Merchant or SDKWORK order item id being refunded.

items.description: Item-level refund allocations persisted in commerce_refund_item.

PaymentRefundItem.description: Unified SDKWORK refund item allocation record.

statementIds.description: Statement ids used for this reconciliation run.

ReconciliationDifference.description: Normalized reconciliation difference row between SDKWORK records and provider statements or events.

rawBody.description: Raw webhook body when signature validation needs original bytes.

WebhookEventCreateRequest.description: Provider webhook delivery payload used to verify, normalize, and store an SDKWORK webhook event.

rawBody.description: Raw webhook body when signature validation needs original bytes.

receivedAt.description: Time when SDKWORK received the provider delivery.

payload.description: Provider-native response payload for allowed native operations.

verified.description: Whether signature verification succeeded for the ingested delivery.
